algorithms.name: Buffer
algorithms.description: Creates projected-distance buffers (Web Mercator for geographic inputs) and publishes a new Polygon layer.

algorithms.name: Clip
algorithms.description: Clips input layer features to an authorized overlay polygon layer.

algorithms.name: Dissolve
algorithms.description: Unions features globally or grouped by an attribute field into a new layer.

cross_engine_dependencies.relation: All tenant/project routes depend on E01 authentication, CSRF, RBAC/ACL, RLS, and project_access_guard.
Reads authorized E02 input layers and publishes derived output sources/layers.
Hosts /pro/tiles/{layer_id}/{z}/{x}/{y}.mvt which converges with E05 tile gateway.
Processing model DAGs include 12 raster algorithm nodes executed against E09 raster primitives.

edge_cases: Processing parameter validation must reject booleans/strings coerced as numbers, NaN/Inf, and out-of-range distance_meters (0.1..500000) or quad_segs (2..16).
DAG cycle detection, invalid step/layer references, and arity validation (binary ops, 3-band RGB, calculator formula 'B' ref) in processing_models.
Job cancellation, retry idempotency, bounded worker concurrency/memory, and recovery after worker crash.
Professional geometry/topology/schema operations must honor pinned revisions, scoped ACL, and fillet interior-vertex preconditions.
